description:
Erection of a rear and side roof dormer extension with
one front roof light.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-R00-EX-101; PL-R00-EX-102; PL-R00-EX-103; PL-R00-EX-104; PL-R00-EX-105; Received: 31 May 2022; SR-R00-PR-101; PL-R00-PR-107; PL-R00-PR-106; PL-R00-PR-105; PL-R00-PR-104; PL-R00-PR-103; PL-R00-PR-102; Received 27/07/2022.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the proposed rear roof dormer extension and side roof dormer extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
